intendedUse: Offline Blender and Roblox asset pack basecolor textures; no external upload performed.
pixelPolicy: Original generated PNGs copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits or resizing.
tileability: Prompted for seamless opposite borders; exact border continuity is not guaranteed by generative output.
